summary: A firmware that turns the FM-1 into a General MIDI sound module with a 16-track song sequencer, using samples cut down from the Fluid R3 SoundFont.
features: All 128 GM programs and a GM drum kit; sounds not editable
16 tracks on any MIDI channel; real-time overdub and step recording
Bar editing with note length, move, loop, copy and paste, with undo
64 song slots sharing about 284 KB of flash; browser piano-roll editor
USB and TRS MIDI in as a multi-channel GM module; no clock sync
Update past 0.9.8: older versions can make a dangerously loud noise

headings: defaults chosen where the hardware or the request was open
